title: Democrat Hakeem Jeffries nominated to be first Black speaker of House next year
description: The full House, including Republicans, is scheduled to vote Jan. 3 for the chamber’s next leader.

description: Incoming Oversight Committee Chairman Robert Garcia wants to investigate the president’s sons, the vice president and others.

title: Hegseth survives impeachment fight, but more political threats await
description: As Democrats promise to force the defense chief from office, his continued favor with the president appears to outweigh any liability he has created — for now.

title: Peltola win doesn’t end DOJ scrutiny of Alaska Senate race, officials say
description: A criminal case is probing whether a spoiler candidate was recruited in an effort to confuse voters.

title: Trump to project friendship with Xi as trade and tech rivalry deepens
description: Tensions between the two largest economic powers have heightened in the weeks leading up to the economic summit in China that starts Wednesday.

title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
description: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.

title: Trump was once celebrated by people distancing themselves from his politics
description: After the president and his political movement took a significant beating in the 2026 midterms, some supporters are changing their tune.

description: Among the recipients of letters from Robert Garcia, incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, are Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, Jared Kushner and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.

description: Both Democrats are back in Washington and seeking to make their case to colleagues before a scheduled vote Dec. 1 by secret ballot.

title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska seat, giving Democrats a 56-44 edge in Senate
description: The race was the last to be called in the Senate, securing Democrats a historic sweep of nine new seats.

title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.

title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
description: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

title: How the East Potomac golf course became a D.C. landmark — and what could happen to it
description: A federal judge is keeping East Potomac Park open for now, but hasn't ordered the government to keep the municipal golf course operational.

title: Project Gryffindor: Meta's plan to get more school kids using Instagram
description: Meta said it launched its "school partnership program" to keep teens safe, but internal documents tell a different story.

title: She retired early to care for family. New work rules for food aid disrupted that
description: The Trump administration's sweeping changes to SNAP food aid mean older adults up to age 65 must work or volunteer to get the benefit.

title: White House pulls FDA nominee amid political pushback
description: Heidi Overton has been questioned by some in the GOP, many Democrats and prominent Make America Healthy Again supporters.

title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat into Democrats' column
description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.

title: Jeffries seeks to shore up support ahead of vote for Democratic speaker nominee
description: The New York Democrat is on track in January to become the first Black American to hold the post.

title: This Texas prosecutor says he’ll investigate Democrats investigating Trump
description: Aaron Reitz, the U.S. attorney in South Texas, has raised eyebrows with his recent letters to lawmakers in Washington. Are they signs of serious probes or just posturing?

title: GOP congressman who lost Colorado swing district will run for Boebert’s seat
description: Rep. Gabe Evans’s move would be the second by a Colorado Republican to seek refuge in the redder 4th District, where Rep. Lauren Boebert recently lost.

title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
description: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

title: GOP Rep. James Comer launches campaign for Kentucky governor
description: Comer announced his campaign weeks before Democrats are set to retake the majority in the House.

title: Trump berates NBC reporter, says she wouldn’t notice ‘broken windows’
description: Trump also called Yamiche Alcindor “pathetic,” while touting his construction projects.

title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
description: Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

title: Trump’s library took in $57.6 million. Its donors are not listed.

title: Judge tosses Max Miller’s suit against ex-wife, says abuse claim ‘substantially true’

title: White House weighs next steps for FDA nominee who faces bipartisan pushback
description: Heidi Overton's nomination has faced an uphill battle as some in the GOP, many Democrats and prominent Make America Healthy Again supporters have questioned or opposed her candidacy.

title: Supreme Court hands Trump a setback on DEI-related grant cancellations
description: The justices declined to consider the administration’s request to revive its cuts to grant funding to researchers at the University of California at Berkeley.
